siblings = []
for c in contacts:
    rels = set(c.get('relationships',[]))
    if rels & {'parent','father','mother'}:
        parents.append(c)
    if rels & {'sibling','brother','sister'}:
        siblings.append(c)

        'contact_id': c['contact_id'],
        'name': f"{c.get('first_name','')} {c.get('last_name','')}",
        'relationships': c.get('relationships',[]),
        'email': c.get('email',''),
        'phone': c.get('phone_number',''),
        'home_address': c.get('home_address','')
    }

    d = fmt_contact(c)

# Also print full details for verification

for c in sorted(contacts, key=lambda x: x['contact_id']):
    print({k:fmt_contact(c)[k] for k in ['contact_id','name','relationships','email','phone','home_address']})
